// diagnostic

E0386

Distributed atom groups need parentheses before `&&` or `||`.

What

Distributed atom groups need parentheses before `&&` or `||`.

Why

A `|` arm head is one distributed group, so its boundary must stay visible before a Boolean operator applies.

Fix

Write `(atom | atom) && guard` or `(atom | atom) || guard`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0386: tests/ui/dispatch_atom_boolean_parens.stderr.

Error [E0386]: distributed atom groups need parentheses before `&&` or `||`.
  --> tests/ui/dispatch_atom_boolean_parens.jet:6:9
    |
  6 |         48 | 45 && ready -> print("hit")
    |         ^^^^^^^
 Why: A `|` arm head is one distributed group, so its boundary must stay visible before a Boolean operator applies.
 Fix: write `(atom | atom) && guard` or `(atom | atom) || guard`.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0386

Error [E0116]: `print` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/dispatch_atom_boolean_parens.jet:6:29
    |
  6 |         48 | 45 && ready -> print("hit")
    |                             ^^^^^
 Why: a call is a value only when its function declares a result after the parameter list
 Fix: inside an arm, wrap the call in `{ … }`; otherwise put `print` on its own line, or declare it as `fn print(…) Type -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
